name: Nakata Shuichi
source:
The main character is lost, feeling isolated and unloved in the world. This has molded him into an apathetic youth. He wants another person to fill his void, by force. He must own them.

[From [url=http://www.ign.com/faqs/2006/sensei-2-walkthrough-adult-title-733648]Ben Woodhouse's Sensei 2 Walkthrough[/url]]
